contracts.definition: changelog.json shape: Array<{ title: string, description: string, date: string (ISO 8601) }>

data_changes.change: Create file with initial seed data for: Footer, Dark Mode Toggle, Back-to-Top Control, and Custom 404 Page.

deferred_decisions: Specific UI library for tooltips (e.g., Radix UI or a custom Tailwind-only implementation). Implementation should prioritize simplicity.
rationale:
The feature requires a new static-ish page and an RSS feed. I've chosen a local JSON file as the single source of truth to minimize complexity as requested. 

The site currently uses a specific zinc palette; the new page will mirror the outer/inner div structure of `app/page.tsx` (bg-zinc-50/dark:bg-black outer, bg-white/dark:bg-black inner) to ensure visual continuity and automatic theme inheritance.

I'm introducing a tooltip component for the relative-to-absolute date hover requirement. The RSS feed will be a Next.js Route Handler to allow for dynamic generation from the JSON source.

Prior decisions honored:
- Using existing zinc theme tokens for consistency.
- Matching the layout pattern of the homepage (outer/inner container structure).
- Supporting light/dark mode via existing `ThemeProvider` and Tailwind classes.

## Memory writes
- decision: Use a local `changelog.json` file as the single source of truth for the changelog page and RSS feed.
- decision: Mirror the homepage layout (bg-zinc-50/dark:bg-black outer, bg-white/dark:bg-black inner) for the `/changelog` page to ensure visual continuity.
- constraint: The changelog page must use existing Tailwind zinc theme tokens for light and dark modes.
- constraint: The RSS feed must use standard ISO 8601 timestamps.

risks.mitigation: Use `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat` or a lightweight library like `date-fns` for consistent relative time strings.
Verify the Content-Type header is set to `application/xml` or `text/xml` in the route handler.
risks.risk: RSS feed failing to parse in feed readers due to incorrect MIME type.

swe_constraints: Match existing site's zinc-based theme (zinc-50, zinc-950, etc.).
Support both light and dark modes via Tailwind 'dark:' classes.
RSS feed must use standard ISO 8601 timestamps.
Tooltip must be accessible and follow existing design patterns.
Stay within the listed components and new files.
